content:
omar: Hey folks — I'm on my first-day laptop (M1 Pro, macOS Ventura). MDM enrollment showed up as complete but System Settings still says 'MDM: Pending profile install' and OneDrive won't sync (error: admin approval required). Anyone seen this?

it-ops-bot: Welcome to Redwood! If you hit issues with enrollment, check the new-hires onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/mac-setup — and ping #it if urgent.

ashley: congrats and welcome! For Apple Silicon there are a couple quirks: check System Settings → Privacy & Security for any approve prompts, and some docks (DisplayLink/CalDigit) need extra driver approvals. Did you get any allow/approve prompts during the initial setup? :wave:

omar: I didn't see any prompts. Dock is a CalDigit TS4; external monitor stays black. Also I can't install some stuff (need Rosetta for one internal binary) — sudo works but I'm not a local admin.

jordan: For Rosetta you can run: `sudo /usr/sbin/softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` — but local admin is required. We try to avoid granting permanent admin. @katie can give a short-lived admin session if you need it.

katie: @omar I can grant admin for a few hours. Before I do, can you paste the serial number from About This Mac and confirm the device name? Also does the MDM page show any error codes?

omar: serial: C02ZQ0XXXXXX, device name: Omar-MBP. MDM page says 'profile download succeeded' but 'payload installation pending'.

it-ops-bot: Quick commands that sometimes unblock enrollment: `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and then `profiles status -type enrollment`. Also check logs: `log show --predicate 'process == "profilesd"' --last 1h`

omar: ran `profiles renew` — it printed 'enrollment renewal attempted'. `profiles status` still shows pending. `log show` contains: `profilesd: Install aborted — payload signature invalid` and a few URL fetch failures.

ashley: that log line usually means the MDM server returned a corrupt/expired payload. Try removing the profiles and re-enrolling: `sudo profiles remove -all` then open the enrollment link in Chrome (avoid Safari if you see weird redirects).

omar: did that, re-enrolled via Chrome. Now System Settings shows 'MDM: Managed' and OneDrive began syncing. Progress! External monitor still blank though.

jordan: For the TS4 sometimes you need CalDigit's driver pkg and then grant Screen Recording + Input Monitoring + Files & Folders in Privacy & Security. On Ventura you may also see a prompt to 'Approve DisplayLink' — accept and reboot.

omar: installed the DisplayLink.pkg from CalDigit, saw an 'Approve DisplayLink' banner in System Settings → Privacy & Security, hit Allow, rebooted — monitors are fine now.

omar: Still need Rosetta to run an old evaluation tool. @katie can I get temporary admin? :)

katie: Granted local admin until 1769961921 (4 hours). Install Rosetta and any required packages, then DM me when you're done so I can revoke.

omar: Ran the Rosetta installer, confirmed legacy binary launches. Everything working now. Thanks for the quick help — will open a tiny PR to the onboarding doc to add a CalDigit/DisplayLink note and the `profiles renew` tip. :memo: :tada:

ashley: lovely, thanks for doing that! And welcome again. If you hit anything else message #it or ping me directly.

omar: will do — appreciate the speedy onboarding help everyone.
